summary: Register self-hosted 1С-Битрикс as a storefront provider with an official REST-module webhook bridge and executable product catalog read/write only.

impacts.evidence: 1С-Битрикс uses the existing tenant-scoped storefront Connector SDK account and per-account non-secret runtime configuration.
Webhook user_id and webhook_code stay behind SecretProvider; product projections retain only bounded remote identifiers and catalog fields.
No public HTTP/OpenAPI operation is added; the connector reuses the existing product reader/writer ports.
No event schema or EventBus contract changes.
The provider implements existing SDK ports only and does not add or change a Connector SDK root contract.
The connector uses the existing encrypted credential and versioned runtime-config stores; no schema migration is required.
Host-mediated transport validates the administrator-supplied host/path, keeps webhook material callback-scoped, bounds bodies and normalizes remote errors.
products.write remains governed by the existing capability and write-policy checks; unsupported inventory/order/price routes cannot be enabled.
Product writes return the existing CommerceWriteReceipt and verify remote state after mutation.
Exact xmlId lookup, duplicate detection, read-after-write verification and ambiguous-outcome reconciliation are implemented.
Outbound calls are restricted to the configured store host through the standard SSRF-safe host transport; inbound webhook receipt is not claimed.
Timeouts, non-2xx responses and malformed Bitrix envelopes map to bounded SDK errors without leaking credentials.
The connector can be disabled per tenant by disabling its account; no migration rollback is needed.
Provider tests and the conformance candidate pass all 13 required checks, including sandbox_isolation with Linux user namespaces enabled; the report is release evidence.
